facts.fact: SMART Zambia has been piloting MOSIP's e-Signet tool since mid-2024 under the Digital Zambia Acceleration Project, to connect the country's digital ID to public services with biometric authentication.
A general procurement notice published in December 2024 lists a consultancy to study existing digital ID elements and suggest a mobile-based digital authentication and digital signatures solution.
facts.system: mobile-based digital authentication and digital signatures solution
